title: Total influence from circuit size
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be computed by a layered circuit of depth $d$ and size at most $s$, where size counts first-layer gates and all non-output gates in the remaining layers. Then $\operatorname{Inf}(f)\le 4(5\lceil\log_2(s)\rceil+4)\bigl(20(\lceil\log_2(s+2)\rceil+2)\bigr)^{d-2}$.
hypotheses_covered: There is a Boolean function f
There are natural numbers d and s
The circuit size is at most s
